# GlobeCareer — International Career Platform

> [GlobeCareer](https://globecareer.online) is a 100% free international CV and resume builder, career document suite, and global job search platform. It features country-specific CV formatting across 40 jurisdictions, ATS optimization, and zero paywalls or subscriptions.

## Core Free Capabilities

- [International Resume Builder](https://globecareer.online/resume-builder): Interactive CV creator with real-time ATS keyword matching, photo and no-photo compliance for 40 countries, and free vector PDF and DOCX export.
- [Resume & CV Templates](https://globecareer.online/templates): Country-tailored single-column ATS layouts and European photo CV formats.
- [Cover Letter Builder](https://globecareer.online/cover-letter-builder): Tailored cover letters with country-specific norms and export.
- [Cover Letter Templates](https://globecareer.online/letter-templates): Curated outreach and reference letter templates.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://globecareer.online/ats-checker): Real-time resume versus job description match score, missing skills analysis, and formatting audits.
- [Job Application Email Generator](https://globecareer.online/email-generator): Formal application emails, cold outreach messages, and follow-ups.
- [Recommendation Letter Builder](https://globecareer.online/recommendation-letter): Academic, employment, and graduate reference letters.
- [Recommendation Letter Guide](https://globecareer.online/recommendation-letter-guide): Step-by-step guidance on requesting and structuring reference letters.
- [Interview Preparation](https://globecareer.online/interview-prep): STAR method frameworks, mock practice questions, and international hiring etiquette.
- [Professional Bio Generator](https://globecareer.online/bio-generator): 15+ industry templates with Short, Medium, and Extended outputs.
- [Resume Summary & Objective Generator](https://globecareer.online/summary-generator): 18+ ATS-tested professional summaries and LinkedIn headlines.
- [Resignation Letter Generator](https://globecareer.online/resignation-letter): 11+ departure scenarios with global notice rules for US, UK, Germany, and Australia.
- [Resume Word Counter](https://globecareer.online/resume-word-counter): Word count and readability analysis for international job applications.
- [Resume Bullet Point Generator](https://globecareer.online/resume-bullet-generator): Action-verb achievement statements tailored for applicant tracking systems.
- [Verified Jobs Portal](https://globecareer.online/jobs): Authenticated international and remote positions with verified employer links and anti-scam safeguards.
- [Job Application Tracker](https://globecareer.online/job-tracker): Free Kanban pipeline for tracking wishlists, applied roles, interviews, offers, and follow-up deadlines.
- [40 Country CV Hiring Guides](https://globecareer.online/country-guides): Specific rules on photos, paper sizes (Letter vs. A4), document length, and data privacy for 40 nations including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Australia, France, Japan, UAE, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, Ireland, New Zealand, Sweden, and Poland.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://globecareer.online/faq): Detailed guidance on resume formats, ATS compliance, photo rules, and international employment.

## Platform Standards

- **100% Free:** No credit cards, no subscriptions, no watermarks, no gated downloads.
- **Privacy First:** Client-side local storage draft persistence.
- **Canonical Domain:** [GlobeCareer Official Site](https://globecareer.online)
- **Sitemap:** [XML Sitemap](https://globecareer.online/sitemap.xml)
